text:
noah_ops: FYI - received a transit alert from forwarder: crate stack on PO 61300 showed water marker and pressure valve failure. Initial depot triage: 6 DOA, 4 flaky. Quarantine at AMS-CD21.

ingrid_procure: numbers and serial ranges? want vendor on the line.

noah_ops: sampled range NEXA-H200-61300-0100..0250. Tested 200, 10 flagged intermittent power-fail/thermal trip after ~15-40m. Photos uploaded to NX-claims.

fwd-broker: SDR filed, photos + container pressure log attached. Pressure drop recorded 2026-04-03T02:18Z. Broker suggests HS amend for repair parts to avoid import duty.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor acknowledges likely packing seal issue. Two proposals: (A) depot refurb + vendor-sent tech kits (ETA 48h to depots) + 2.5% credit, (B) expedite air replacements for critical qty at vendor expense but need insurer sign-off.

tara_sales: customer impact: APAC reservations next week will be hit. We need at least 8 expedited to cover top S1 customers, otherwise route short-term from US buffer.

rma-bot: Draft RMA created RMA-2026-6344 (unit_count=10, preflight_required=true). Attach invoices for credit reconciliation.

noah_ops: technical ops ask: any repaired/replaced unit must include per-serial bench logs: bench_id, therm_profile, kv_cache_retention graph, and power-cycle trace. Also require vendor-run 45m thermal burn + our depot 30m verification before redeploy.

depot-tech: added KV retention to depot script. Will run on flagged units and tag serials with `water_contact` or `rma-suspect`.

ingrid_procure: commercial ask to vendor: cover return freight + import duty rebate if insurer denies claim, provide 4% credit if we accept depot refurb. If vendor won't meet that, push for 8 expedited air units + 3% credit.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor counter: 3% credit + return freight covered for failed units if we accept depot refurb. Expedite 6 units in 5 days at vendor cost if we sign limited salvage acknowledgment. They refuse blanket 4% credit.

ingrid_procure: salvage ack is risky for insurance. Do not sign until adjuster confirms. Also require vendor to provide per-serial bench logs for depot repairs; no bench logs for salvaged units unless vendor agrees.

tara_sales: I'll draft a short customer note if we commit to expedite: "We’ve quarantined a small subset of H200s due to transit damage. Critical customers prioritized; replacements in progress. Daily updates." Keep calm tone.

noah_ops: ops checklist for next 6h: 1) run depot 30m burn on 24 random units, 2) tag failing serials, 3) prepare crossdock order CD-61300-AMS (hold), 4) await vendor commercial amendment. I own 1-2.

rma-bot: Reminder: include original invoices in RMA to enable vendor credit reconciliation.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor to send revised terms in 2h. We'll insist on per-serial preflight logs AND a clause: vendor must replace any unit that fails our depot preflight within 3 days at vendor expense.

ingrid_procure: agreed. If vendor signs 8 air units + per-serial logs + return freight + duty rebate clause, accept. Otherwise accept 3% + depot refurb with vendor-covered freight and strict preflight SLA.

depot-tech: posting first 8 depot logs in ~50m. Will tag `rma-water` serials.

tara_sales: tag me when amendment signed and I'll prepare customer comms.

noah_ops: final ops note - require bench files in CSV and compressed tarball per shipment. Add that to RMA metadata.

nexa_supply_ops: will push that to vendor. If vendor refuses, escalate to procurement lead.

ingrid_procure: call scheduled in 45m with vendor + broker + claims adjuster. Goal: lock at least 8 expedited replacements or final concession terms.

noah_ops: thx all. posting photos and initial logs now. :mag:
